title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Civic Center / UN Plaza | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Civic Center / UN Plaza Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STREET ELEVATOR

Can't enter station: Use the Powell St. Station street elevator at Market and Ellis streets (0.5 miles/ 5 blocks). Go to the intersection of McAllister and Leavenworth streets to take a bus to Market at Powell Street.
Can't exit station: Continue on train to exit at another station. The closest station is Powell St. (0.5 miles).
PLATFORM ELEVATOR

Can't enter station: Use the Powell St. Station street elevator at Market and Ellis streets (0.5 miles/ 5 blocks). Go to the intersection of McAllister and Leavenworth streets to take a bus to Market at Powell Street.
Can't exit station: Continue on train to exit at another station. The closest station is Powell St. (0.5 miles).

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Coliseum | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Coliseum Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
STATION ELEVATOR
Can't enter station: Take another mode of transportation such as an AC Transit bus to another station. The closest station is Fruitvale (2.1 miles).
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to exit at another station. The closest station is Fruitvale (2.1 miles).
ELEVATOR TO OAKLAND AIRPORT CONNECTOR
Can't access connector platform: Take another mode of transportation such as an AC Transit bus to get to the Oakland airport.
Can’t exit connect connector platform: Go back to the Oakland Airport Station and take another mode of transportation such as an AC Transit bus to get back to the Oakland Coliseum Station.
WHEELCHAIR LIFT FROM STATION TO PARKING LOT
Can't enter station: Access the entrance on the other side of the station. From the parking area, turn right on Snell Street, left on 69th Street, and left on San Leandro Boulevard.

Can't exit station: Exit the station on the San Leandro Boulevard side and use surface streets to access the main parking area. From the station entrance, turn right on San Leandro Boulevard, right on 69th Street, and right on Snell Street.
PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE ELEVATOR TO ARENA
Can't access arena: Cross San Leandro Blvd and go South one block. Turn right on 73rd Street to access the ramp to the pedestrian bridge from the Amtrak parking lot and proceed to the arena.
Can't leave arena: Take the ramp down from the pedestrian bridge to the Amtrak parking lot. Walk or roll along 73rd St one block to get back to the Coliseum BART Station.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For Daly City | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - Daly City Station
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORMS 1 AND 2 ELEVATOR (EAST BAY DIRECTION)
Can't enter station: Take the elevator on the opposite platform and go back to Colma to board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Balboa Park and then return to Daly City. Exit using Platform 3 elevator.
PLATFORM 3 ELEVATOR (SFO/MILLBRAE DIRECTION)
Can't enter station: Take the elevator on the opposite platform and go back to Balboa park to board desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Colma and then return to Daly City. Exit using the Platform 1/2 elevator.
ELEVATORS TO PEDESTRIAN TUNNEL
Can't enter station from tunnel: Drive, walk, or roll to the main station entrance on De Long Street (about 0.3 miles). Turn right on John Daly Boulevard and then left on De Long Street.

Can't exit station from tunnel: Walk or roll about 0.3 miles to the parking area on the other side of the tunnel. Exit the station and take the ramp to the De Long Street parking lot. Cross the parking lot and turn right on John Daly Boulevard.

title: BART Elevator Locations And Accessible Path For El Cerrito del Norte | Bay Area Rapid Transit

blocks.text: Elevator Outage Options - El Cerrito del Norte
In case of an elevator outage, use the following options or contact the station agent for assistance. Agents can arrange a ride to a different station in an accessible van if needed.
PLATFORM 1 ELEVATOR (RICHMOND DIRECTION)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 2 elevator on the opposite platform and travel to El Cerrito Plaza, then board the desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to Richmond then return to El Cerrito del Norte and exit using the elevator on the opposite platform (Platform 2).
PLATFORM 2 ELEVATOR (BERRYESSA, SFO/MILLBRAE/DALY CITY DIRECTION)
Can't enter station: Take the Platform 1 elevator to the opposite platform and travel to Richmond Station, then board the desired train.
Can't exit station: Continue on BART to El Cerrito Plaza and then return to El Cerrito del Norte. Exit using Platform 1 elevator.
